intro.zh: 全自动：按组勾选算法（深度、法线、摄影机、位置 / 点云、光流与对位、光照与材质、画面清理），每组可一键全开 / 全关；开着的每个算法交付一层，进同一个多层 EXR（层名 = 组.算法，如 depth.da3），也可每层另存；摄影机、点云、HDRI 各出文件。所有结果同一台摄影机、同一尺度：有上传的摄影机就用它，否则用 ViPE 求的。深度按 ViPE 深度（非商用）定尺度，所以交付标为非商用。缺素材的算法不算。抠像、跟踪在另外两张卡。
intro.en: Fully automatic: tick algorithms by group (depth, normals, camera, position, flow, lighting, plate cleanup), each group on / off at once. Each one on is a layer of one multi-layer EXR (group.algorithm, e.g. depth.da3); camera, points and HDRI get their own files. One camera and scale for all: yours if uploaded, else ViPE's. Depths are scaled to ViPE's depth (non-commercial), so the delivery is non-commercial. Matting and tracking are on two other cards.

label.zh: 已有摄影机（可不传，不传就用 ViPE 求）
